We are looking for a Senior Network & Kubernetes Migration Specialist (6-9 years' experience) to lead and execute large-scale AWS network and container platform migration initiatives. This role requires deep expertise in AWS networking, enterprise hybrid connectivity, and strong hands-on experience with Amazon EKS from both infrastructure and application perspectives. Roles & Responsibilities: - Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform. - Responsible for team decisions. - Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions. - Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams. - Lead efforts to identify and implement best practices within the team to improve software quality and delivery. - Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and enhance team capabilities. - Lead end-to-end migration of on-premises and hybrid network environments to AWS. - Design complex AWS networking architectures including multi-account VPC strategy, subnet segmentation, routing, NAT, IGW, and load balancing. - Architect and implement AWS Transit Gateway (hub-and-spoke, inter-region, multi-account connectivity). - Design hybrid connectivity using AWS Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, and BGP routing. - Perform network segmentation aligned with zero-trust principles. - Lead migration risk assessment, rollback planning, and phased cutover strategies. - Optimize network cost, latency, and high availability post migration. - Define and enforce enterprise-grade security policies using Security Groups, NACLs, AWS Network Firewall, and third-party firewalls. - Implement inspection VPC and centralized egress architectures. - Collaborate with security teams on compliance and regulatory requirements. - Implement guardrails using SCPs and IAM boundaries. - Design and operate production-grade Amazon EKS clusters. - Architect multi-cluster and multi-environment EKS strategies. - Design cluster networking (CNI, IP management, pod density planning). - Optimize VPC CNI, prefix delegation, and subnet sizing. - Implement cluster autoscaling using Karpenter and Cluster Autoscaler. - Manage node lifecycle, taints/tolerations, and capacity planning. - Implement IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts). - Upgrade and patch Kubernetes clusters with minimal downtime. - Support application teams in migrating workloads to Kubernetes. - Design ingress strategies (ALB / NGINX Ingress). - Optimize application networking (Services, Network Policies, DNS). - Troubleshoot pod-to-pod and cross-cluster communication issues. - Implement scalability and resilience patterns (HPA, PDB, readiness/liveness probes). - Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform (modular approach). - Implement GitOps workflows using Argo CD. - Build CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Jenkins. - Define policy-as-code using Kyverno. - Develop automation scripts using Python or Go. Professional & Technical Skills: Must Have Skills: Proficiency in AWS Networking. - Good To Have Skills: Kubernetes. - Strong knowledge of cloud networking concepts including virtual private clouds, subnets, routing, and security groups. - Experience with designing and implementing scalable network architectures in cloud environments. - Familiarity with automation tools and scripting to manage network infrastructure efficiently. - Ability to troubleshoot complex network issues and optimize network performance. - 6-9 years of experience in AWS infrastructure, networking, and cloud migrations. - Strong expertise in AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, and VPN. - Deep understanding of enterprise networking concepts (BGP, routing, firewalls, segmentation). - Strong production experience with Amazon EKS (cluster design, scaling, networking optimization). - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes networking internals. - Strong Terraform expertise (module design, remote state management). - Experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines. - Scripting experience with Python or Go. - Strong troubleshooting and stakeholder communication skills. Additional Information: - The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in AWS Networking. - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. - A 15-year full-time education is required. Qualification 15 years full time education 5-10 Yrs nan

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Senior
jobs.description: Role Summary AI only earns trust in government when it is accurate, explainable and secure. The Senior AI Engineer leads the design, build and deployment of production-grade AI and GenAI solutions on governed, high- quality data. They own the technical architecture and quality of AI solutions end to end, turning complex use cases into reliable applications that are measurable, auditable and compliant with UAE AI and data regulation. The role works alongside business analysts, data architects, data engineers and the Data Governance Council, and acts as the technical lead and mentor for junior AI engineers. Its job is to take AI from prototype to production at scale, using the Microsoft Azure AI ecosystem on top of the Purview- governed data foundation, and to set the engineering and responsible-AI standards the team follows. Key Responsibilities on the Client s Engagement AI solution architecture and engineering: Lead the end-to-end design, development and deployment of AI/ML and GenAI applications, including RAG assistants, document intelligence, classification, prediction and Arabic/English NLP use cases, from use-case shaping through to production operations. GenAI and RAG architecture: Architect enterprise-scale retrieval-augmented generation solutions using Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, vector indexing, hybrid retrieval and re- ranking, agentic and prompt orchestration, and grounding on curated Gold-layer data, optimising for accuracy, latency and cost. Responsible AI governance: Define and operationalise responsible-AI controls covering explainability, bias testing, content safety, hallucination controls and human-in-the-loop review, aligned to the UAE Charter for the Development and Use of AI and Dubai s AI ethics principles, and present them to the Data Governance Council. Secure integration and platform design: Design secure, scalable APIs and integration patterns that connect AI capabilities with enterprise applications, portals and analytics, with role-based access, data masking, private networking and identity controls enforced. Data readiness: Partner with data architects and data engineers to define AI-ready data products, feature pipelines and data-quality gates, and ensure training and grounding data meets DQ and classification controls. Evaluation and benchmarking: Establish the evaluation framework: accuracy, relevance, latency and cost KPIs, automated regression testing, red-teaming and go/no-go release criteria applied before each release. MLOps and LLMOps: Own CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, monitoring, drift detection, observability and cost management for AI workloads in production. Privacy and security: Lead the application of UAE PDPL, Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR requirements to AI workloads, including threat modelling, data residency, PII handling and prompt/response logging, in coordination with security and data-protection teams. Technical leadership and mentoring: Act as technical lead for the AI workstream: lead and mentor junior AI engineers, run design and code reviews, set engineering standards and best practices, and support estimation, planning and delivery quality. Stakeholder advisory: Advise senior business and technology stakeholders on AI feasibility, risk, roadmap and trade-offs, and translate business needs into clear technical solutions and delivery plans. Documentation: Produce and review model cards, solution architecture and design decisions, runbooks and audit evidence for each AI component. Knowledge transfer: Lead capability building for Client s counterparts in AI engineering practices, tooling and responsible-AI operations so that solutions can be sustained after handover. Qualifications and Experience 8+ years in software engineering, with at least 4 years designing, building and deploying AI/ML or GenAI solutions in production, including ownership of multiple enterprise-scale deployments. Proven experience as a technical lead, guiding and mentoring a team of engineers and owning solution architecture and delivery quality. Expert-level Python skills, with deep experience in frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, PyTorch, scikit-learn or Hugging Face, and in building agentic and multi-step LLM workflows. Deep hands-on experience with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning and vector databases, including hybrid retrieval, evaluation and fine-tuning approaches. Strong experience designing scalable APIs and services (REST/FastAPI), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code. Strong command of MLOps/LLMOps, model evaluation, prompt engineering, red-teaming, observability and responsible-AI practices. Solid understanding of lakehouse architecture, Microsoft Fabric and governed data consumption through Purview. Working knowledge of UAE AI and data regulation, including the UAE AI Charter, UAE PDPL, the Dubai Data Law and DESC ISR, with experience applying it in delivery; experience in government or other regulated sectors is an advantage. Excellent English communication, documentation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to present to senior leadership; Arabic proficiency and Arabic NLP experience are an advantage. Preferred: relevant Microsoft Azure AI or architecture certifications (for example Azure AI Engineer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert). Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying. 8-13 Yrs Machine, Prototype, Python, Software testing, Artificial Intelligence, Quality, Enterprise applications, Senior

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description: Role Summary: HCLSoftware is seeking a Domain and Product Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join the Incubate Delivery function. This role sits within the build pool and is responsible for customising and configuring Incubate solutions to deliver the specific business outcomes each customer engagement requires. The Domain and Product FDE acts on behalf of the client. They take the requirements and detailed design produced by the Value Owner and Context and Data Strategist and turn them into working solutions inside the product, designing workflows, configuring orchestrations, building workbenches, and implementing process-led use cases using deep product fluency and domain understanding. This is not a core product development role. The Incubate product and solution teams own the architecture, engineering, and roadmap of the core products. This role makes those products work in the customers environment, configuring, extending, and customising them to deliver the outcomes the engagement has been designed to achieve. In traditional delivery, this would be recognised as a Product Specialist or Domain SME. In AIcentred delivery, the distinction matters more. Solutions built on AI, orchestration, and agentic capabilities need people who understand both the product and the business domain well enough to configure intelligently without defaulting to unnecessary custom development, and without losing sight of what the customer is actually trying to achieve. The role requires the judgement to know when to configure versus when to customise, when to use product capability as intended versus when to extend it, and when to push back on a requirement that would be better served by a different approach. That judgement comes from combining product knowledge with practical domain understanding. Role Scope in Practice Design, configure, and build customer-specific solutions within Incubate products, including workflows, orchestrations, workbenches, agents, and process-led use cases. Work from the documented requirements and detailed design produced by the Context and Data Strategist, translating specification into working product configuration. Apply domain understanding and product fluency to make informed configuration decisions that deliver the desired outcomes without unnecessary custom development. Collaborate with AI Orchestration and Engineering colleagues where solutions require integration, API connectivity, or technical build beyond product configuration. 2 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Support the Quality and Compliance team by ensuring that what is built is testable, traceable, and aligned to the documented requirements and acceptance criteria. Participate in delivery calls and technical discussions where product and domain input is needed, without owning customer communication directly. Contribute to the reuse and maturity of solution patterns, configuration approaches, and domain-specific knowledge across engagements. Configure and maintain the behavioural controls that shape how AI agents operate within each customer's context, including prompt templates, agent personas, business guardrails, and escalation logic, ensuring agents behave in line with the process, the client's operating context, and the documented acceptance criteria. Key Responsibilities 1. Solution Configuration and Build Design and configure solutions within Incubate products to meet the specific requirements of each customer engagement. Build workflows, orchestrations, workbenches, agents, and process-led use cases using the product’s native capabilities and tooling. Make informed decisions about when to use standard product configuration, when to extend or customise, and when to escalate where a requirement may be better addressed through a different approach. Ensure that configured solutions are robust, maintainable, and aligned to the product’s intended architecture and design patterns. Work iteratively, delivering incremental capability that can be reviewed, validated, and refined through the engagement lifecycle. Design and configure prompt templates, agent personas, and behavioural parameters that control how AI agents interact with users, data, and business processes within each use case. Implement business guardrails and constraints that keep agent behaviour aligned to the customer's expectations, regulatory context, and risk appetite, including tone, scope boundaries, escalation triggers, and response limitations. 2. Domain Expertise and Product Fluency Bring practical understanding of the business domain to inform how solutions are designed and configured, ensuring they reflect how the customer’s processes, decisions, and workflows actually operate. Maintain deep fluency in Incubate product capabilities, tooling, and configuration options, staying current as products evolve. Use domain and product knowledge together to identify the most effective solution approach for each use case, avoiding over-engineering and unnecessary complexity. Advise the Context and Data Strategist and Value Owner where requirements may benefit from adjustment based on product capability or domain insight. Establish and maintain SME feedback loops working with customer subject matter experts to review agent behaviour, validate output quality, and iteratively refine prompt templates and behavioural configuration based on real-world performance. 3 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes 3. Working from Requirements and Detailed Design Take documented requirements and detailed design from the Context and Data Strategist as the primary input for build work. Seek clarification from the Context and Data Strategist where specifications are ambiguous, incomplete, or where product constraints create a gap between what is specified and what can be delivered. Ensure traceability between documented requirements and what is actually built, so that QA and validation activities have a clear baseline. Flag risks, constraints, and dependencies back to the delivery team early, particularly where product limitations or data readiness issues may affect the planned approach. 4. Collaboration and Delivery Integration Work as part of the integrated delivery team, collaborating closely with AI Orchestration and Engineering colleagues, the Context and Data Strategist, and the Quality and Compliance team. Participate in delivery ceremonies, technical discussions, and review sessions as needed. Support solution walkthroughs and demonstrations where product and domain expertise is required, without owning customer communication directly. Coordinate with other Domain and Product FDEs where multiple use cases or workstreams are running in parallel within an engagement. 5. Quality, Testing, and Handover Ensure that configured solutions are built to a standard that supports effective testing, validation, and acceptance. Support the Quality and Compliance team in validating that delivered solutions meet the documented requirements, acceptance criteria, and governance standards. Contribute to go-live readiness activities, including solution documentation, configuration records, and handover materials for the operate phase. Support operate-phase activities where ongoing configuration, refinement, or extension of solutions is required after initial go-live. 6. Knowledge Sharing and Reuse Contribute to the development of reusable solution patterns, configuration templates, and domain-specific knowledge across the function. Document configuration decisions, design rationale, and lessons learned so that knowledge is retained and transferable. Share product and domain expertise with colleagues across engagements, supporting the function’s ability to mobilise and deliver consistently. Required Experience Experience in a product configuration, solution delivery, or domain specialist role within enterprise software environments. Practical experience designing and building solutions using enterprise software products, configuring workflows, orchestrations, business rules, or process automation. 4 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Demonstrable domain understanding in one or more relevant business areas, able to translate business processes and requirements into product configuration decisions. Experience working from documented requirements and detailed design, collaborating with business analysts or equivalent roles to clarify and refine specifications. Experience working as part of a multi-disciplinary delivery team, coordinating with engineering, QA, and advisory colleagues. Comfortable working iteratively, delivering incremental capability and adapting as requirements are refined through delivery. Skills and Capabilities Product fluency: able to work confidently within enterprise software products, using native tooling and configuration capabilities to build effective solutions. Domain understanding: brings practical knowledge of business processes, operational workflows, and industry context that informs how solutions are designed and configured. Configuration judgement: knows when to use standard configuration, when to extend, and when to push back, including the judgement to shape agent behaviour through prompt design and guardrails rather than defaulting to custom development. Analytical thinking: able to interpret requirements, identify gaps or ambiguities, and translate specification into working solutions. Collaboration: works effectively as part of an integrated team, particularly alongside Context and Data Strategists, AI Orchestration engineers, and QA colleagues. Communication: able to articulate technical decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Attention to detail: builds solutions that are robust, traceable, and aligned to documented requirements. Desirable Experience Experience with HCLSoftware products or comparable enterprise software platforms. Experience in AI, automation, orchestration, or agentic workflow delivery, understanding how product configuration differs when AI is at the centre of the solution. Experience with process mining, process mapping, or operational analytics tools. Familiarity with integration patterns, APIs, and data connectivity in the context of enterprise solution delivery. Experience in environments where governance, compliance, and auditability are embedded in the delivery process. Experience supporting operate-phase activities: extending, optimising, and refining solutions after initial go-live. Experience configuring or managing AI agents, conversational AI, or LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, behavioural tuning, and agent persona design. 5 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Success Measures Months 1 to 3: Embedded and Building Integrated into active engagements and building solutions productively within Incubate products. Working effectively from documented requirements, with minimal rework caused by misinterpretation of specifications. Demonstrating product fluency and domain understanding that inform sound configuration decisions. Collaborating well with Context and Data Strategists, AI Orchestration colleagues, and the Quality and Compliance team. Months 3 to 6: Quality and Consistency Configured solutions consistently meet documented requirements and acceptance criteria, with minimal defects or rework at validation. Configuration decisions reflect good judgement: using product capability effectively, avoiding unnecessary custom development, and escalating appropriately where product constraints arise. Positive feedback from the delivery team on the quality, reliability, and maintainability of built solutions. Contributing to solution documentation and configuration records that support operatephase handover. Months 6 to 12: Depth and Reuse Recognised as a reliable, high-quality contributor to solution build across Incubate engagements. Contributing reusable solution patterns, configuration templates, and domain-specific knowledge to the function. Building depth of product and domain expertise that supports more complex use cases and engagement scenarios. Supporting the mobilisation of new engagements with established patterns and lessons from prior work. Candidate Profile Technically capable and product-oriented, with a genuine interest in how enterprise software solves business problems. Pragmatic and outcome-focused, builds solutions that work for the customer, not just solutions that are technically elegant. Comfortable working from documented requirements and collaborating closely with advisory and QA colleagues. Good judgement on when to configure, when to customise, and when to push back. Curious about the business domain, not just the product, wants to understand why something is being built, not just how. 6 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Reliable, thorough, and motivated by delivering quality work that others can build on. Eager to learn, develop product depth, and grow domain expertise over time. 8-12 Yrs SQL, Integration, Microsoft, Rest, Continuous Integration, Machine learning, Continuous Integration, AWS

Ongoing Education: Stay sharp with company-sponsored professional certification programs. Rapid Career Progression: As a foundational member of a growing GenAI team, your professional development will outpace traditional firms, offering three years of experience in just one. Advanced AI Toolkit: Maximize your efficiency with fully subsidized access to leading premium AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot. Remote-First Culture: Enjoy the flexibility to work from any location in India, focusing on results rather than rigid hours. We facilitate optional in-person meetups at a central location to foster team synergy. Founder Collaboration: Avoid bureaucracy by working directly with founders on frameworks and major global projects. If you are a driven engineer with a deep interest in software engineering and Agentic AI, we invite you to apply. Join our early-stage startup, where we prize innovation and creativity, and help us redefine the future of insights discovery and knowledge management. jobs.description: Enterprise GenAI Solutions | LLM Architecture | Agentic AI | Production Engineering Experience: 3–6 years overall, including a minimum of 3 years of hands-on Generative AI solution engineering experience Role Level: Senior AI Engineer / Lead GenAI Engineer (Individual Contributor) Primary Focus: Architect, engineer, deploy, and scale enterprise-grade Generative AI applications Mandatory: Proven production deployment experience. Proofs of Concept (PoCs), prototypes, hackathons, and experimental trials will not qualify toward the mandatory 3 years of production GenAI experience. A. GenAI Solution Architecture & Engineering Design end-to-end enterprise GenAI application architectures covering UI, API gateways, orchestration, model inference, retrieval, enterprise data integration, observability, security, and infrastructure. Build production-grade LLM-powered applications for enterprise knowledge management, intelligent document processing, engineering assistants, workflow automation, and decision support. Design architectures supporting multi-tenancy, high availability, fault tolerance, scalability, extensibility, and disaster recovery. Implement structured outputs, function/tool calling, context engineering, memory management, and intelligent model routing. Evaluate architectural trade-offs among hosted proprietary models, open-weight models, self-hosted inference, and hybrid deployments. Design model-agnostic integration layers to minimize vendor lock-in. Apply asynchronous processing, caching, batching, rate limiting, and fallback strategies to optimize production applications. B. Advanced RAG & Enterprise Knowledge Systems Architect and implement advanced RAG systems with production-ready ingestion, indexing, retrieval, generation, and evaluation. Develop document ingestion and processing pipelines for PDFs, Office documents, HTML, structured data, and scanned content. Implement semantic chunking, metadata-aware indexing, embedding strategies, hybrid search, and reranking. Design query rewriting, multi-query retrieval, hierarchical retrieval, and advanced retrieval patterns where appropriate. Integrate vector databases and enterprise search platforms. Ensure document-level and user-level access controls are preserved during retrieval. Establish mechanisms for source attribution, grounded answers, hallucination reduction, and retrieval quality monitoring. Manage document versioning, re-indexing, incremental ingestion, and data freshness. C. Agentic AI & Workflow Orchestration Design and implement multi-step, tool-using AI agents with explicit workflow orchestration and state management. Build controlled agentic workflows using LangGraph, equivalent orchestration frameworks, or custom implementations. Integrate AI agents with enterprise APIs, databases, business applications, and automation platforms. Implement guardrails, human-in-the-loop approval gates, tool authorization, and escalation mechanisms. Apply bounded autonomy, execution limits, timeout handling, idempotency, retries, and compensating transactions. Maintain auditable decision traces, tool execution records, and explanations for consequential agent actions. Evaluate the suitability of deterministic workflows versus agent-based architectures based on business risks and requirements. D. Production Engineering, LLMOps & Scalability Develop scalable backend services using Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, and asynchronous programming. Package and deploy applications using Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native infrastructure. Establish production-grade LLMOps practices covering model configuration, prompt versioning, evaluation gates, deployment, monitoring, and rollback. Implement observability across application traces, model calls, retrieval operations, agent execution, and infrastructure. Optimize p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, token consumption, inference cost, and infrastructure utilization. Implement load testing, performance benchmarking, failure recovery, and production incident management. Support cloud, hybrid, and on-premises deployment environments. Define service-level objectives (SLOs), operational runbooks, and production support processes. E. AI Quality, Evaluation & Responsible AI Develop automated evaluation pipelines for retrieval performance, answer faithfulness, relevance, completeness, and task success. Build representative golden datasets and regression test suites. Implement human evaluation and LLM-as-judge methodologies with appropriate calibration and validation. Evaluate agents for tool-selection correctness, workflow completion, policy compliance, and unsafe actions. Implement controls against prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, unauthorized tool execution, and insecure retrieval. Apply enterprise IAM, RBAC/ABAC, encryption, secrets management, audit logging, and data retention requirements. Work within applicable AI governance and security standards, including relevant practices from ISO/IEC 42001 and OWASP guidance for LLM applications. F. Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) & Stakeholder Engagement A critical requirement of this role is the ability to operate as a Forward Deployed Engineer, combining technical depth with direct business engagement and accountable delivery. Work directly with customers and business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and translate them into viable AI solution architectures. Lead technical discovery, requirements engineering, feasibility assessment, solution design, implementation, and production deployment. Independently investigate complex enterprise environments, legacy applications, data constraints, and integration challenges. Develop reusable architectural patterns, accelerators, deployment templates, and AI engineering assets. Conduct architecture reviews and explain design decisions to engineering teams, leadership, and non-technical stakeholders. Drive adoption, knowledge transfer, user enablement, and operational handover. Take ownership of delivered solutions beyond release, including performance, stability, business value, and continuous improvement. Roles and Responsibilities We are seeking a highly capable, hands-on Senior Generative AI Engineer with strong Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) capabilities to architect, build, integrate, and operate scalable, secure, production-grade AI solutions. The ideal candidate must demonstrate deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI, AI application architecture, cloud-native engineering, and enterprise system integration. This position requires more than knowledge of AI frameworks or the ability to develop prototypes. Candidates must have successfully delivered end-to-end GenAI applications into enterprise production environments, with measurable business outcomes, operational reliability, security controls, and sustained usage. The engineer will work directly with business stakeholders, solution architects, enterprise IT teams, and global customers to translate complex business challenges into reliable AI-powered solutions. We are looking for an AI solution builder and production owner—not solely an AI researcher, prompt engineer, or PoC developer Required Production Experience — Strict Qualification Minimum 3 years of verifiable, hands-on GenAI production solution experience is mandatory. The following will not be counted toward this requirement: Academic projects, hackathons, tutorials, and certification exercises. Candidates must have participated substantially in the production lifecycle, rather than merely demonstrating an application. Qualifying experience includes architecture, implementation, enterprise integration, deployment, operational monitoring, incident resolution, and production enhancements. Evidence required: Candidates should be able to describe at least two enterprise GenAI deployments in which they had significant hands-on engineering responsibility, including architecture, their individual contribution, production scale, operational constraints, measurable performance, and lessons learned.
